title: SliceRequest
description: The owner's request for a slice, as the workflow one-slice passes it on; or that request with planter set, as the workflow rounds passes it on, since a planter writes bugs there.

planter.description: A planter writes bugs after the last round when an item asks for bugs caught.

leftovers.description: Each branch an earlier run left that may hold work, with the commit it points at; empty when there is none.

branch.description: The branch an earlier run left.

commit.description: The commit it points at, in full.

request.description: The slice the owner asks forge to build: a planned slice from a plan, the commit to cut it from, the bugs to inject, written by whoever plans or reviews it, and the interface files it builds against.

planned.description: One slice of a plan, in the form of a plan's slice: its title and the slice as proof@1 judges it.

title.description: What the slice delivers, in one sentence the owner reads.

base.description: The commit the slice is cut from: a full or short hash, or a branch name.

bugs.description: The bugs proof injects, never written by the builder; empty when there are none.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, relative to the project, such as schema files and interface .yaml files fixed before the build. Empty when the slice names none.

name.description: The rule's name, the name of its pure function.

module.description: The module that holds the rule.

decides.description: What the rule decides, in the designer's sentence.

takes.description: Every value the rule takes, each its name, its schema and, when it is read from a table or file, its store.

gives.description: Every value the rule gives back, each its name, its schema and, when it is written to a table or file, its store; when it refuses, the refusal sentence in their place.

appliedBy.description: Each action of the slice that applies the rule, with the tables and files its thin function reads before and writes after.

rules.description: The rules of the committed design that the slice's actions apply, each a pure function with what it takes and gives and the actions that apply it; forge's plan adds them to each slice it hands on. Left out, the slice applies none the design names.

action.description: The action of the design the slice builds, as <interface>.<action>, such as todo.add.

mode.description: The one module of the design that offers the action's interface, which is the mode called; left out when none or more than one does, and then its examples are not tried.

examples.description: The action's worked examples as the committed design gives them, in its order: each an input, the earlier calls it starts from, and its answer or the sentence of its refusal; a long text may be said by rule.

The design's worked examples of each action the slice builds, by the request files it names; forge's plan adds them to each slice it hands on, and the merge card says what the built mode answered to each. Left out, none is tried.
